title: DWG LAYOUT viewport list versus DXF entity-space representation
mode: Primary-source DXF specification review plus independent open-source implementation cross-check
scope: Determine whether the DWG LAYOUT counted viewport-handle list has a direct DXF LAYOUT group-code counterpart.
Separate LAYOUT 331, VIEWPORT 68/69, and per-entity layout ownership roles.
Refine the local PAR-20/7G.3 output contract without promoting consumer or support claims.

method.kind: Official Autodesk DXF reference review and ezdxf published API review
method.peer_runtime: LibreDWG dwgread 0.14, installed at /opt/homebrew/bin/dwgread; read-only JSON output over the 10 existing AC1024 repository samples.
method.limitations: Autodesk DXF tables define the documented interchange roles but do not establish how any native consumer reconstructs or orders every DWG-only viewport-list entry. ezdxf is corroborating implementation evidence, not a normative source or native AutoCAD result. LibreDWG 0.14 runtime observations cover only the existing AC1024 sample corpus; its static dwggrep.c matcher labels the list target VPORT while its JSON runtime resolves these samples' listed handles to VIEWPORT entities. The sequence-order semantics remain unresolved.

sources.name: Autodesk LAYOUT DXF group-code table
sources.observed: The documented LAYOUT fields include the associated paper-space BLOCK_RECORD (330), last-active viewport (331), shade-plot reference (333), and UCS references (345/346); there is no counted viewport-handle-list field in the table.

sources.name: Autodesk common DXF entity group-code table
sources.observed: Graphical entity common fields identify code 330 as the owner BLOCK_RECORD and code 410 as the layout tab name, providing the DXF entity-space ownership route.

sources.name: Autodesk VIEWPORT DXF group-code table
sources.observed: Code 68 expresses off/off-screen/active stacking state; code 69 is viewport ID. Neither table says either value is the DWG LAYOUT list ordinal.

sources.name: Autodesk ObjectARX AcDbLayout::getViewportArray API
sources.observed: The API returns IDs for all AcDbViewport entities in the layout's paperspace; the first ID is the paperspace viewport, and an empty result means the layout has never been activated. This is first-party object-model evidence for VIEWPORT entity targets, distinct from DXF group-code documentation.

sources.name: LibreDWG dwggrep LAYOUT matcher
sources.observed: The current static matcher declares LAYOUT.viewports[i] with target type VPORT. Treat this as a peer implementation label, not a DWG format authority.

sources.name: LibreDWG 0.14 JSON runtime on repository AC1024 corpus
sources.revision: dwgread 0.14; local installed binary; source files under tests/samples/AC1024/; command: dwgread -O JSON <sample>
sources.observed: All listed handles in the 8 samples with populated LAYOUT.viewports arrays resolved by handle to JSON records with entity=VIEWPORT; 2 of 10 samples had no populated array. In title_block-iso.dwg, LAYOUT viewport list and active_viewport both target handle 0x52, whose record is VIEWPORT; a separate VPORT record uses handle 0x7f. This conflicts with the static matcher label and remains AC1024 corpus evidence only.

sources.name: ezdxf 1.4.5 Layout Types API
sources.observed: The API describes layouts as owners of their entity space, exposes paperspace viewports(), and provides main_viewport() separately. This corroborates entity-space reconstruction but does not set a normative DWG-list-to-DXF-order mapping.

plan_effect.local_output_contract: For the reviewed AC1024 corpus, treat the DWG listed targets as typed paper-space VIEWPORT entities; represent membership in DXF through the complete retained paper-space entity set with resolved BLOCK_RECORD ownership and layout identity, while serializing the distinct LAYOUT 331 last-active reference separately. Other versions/profiles remain trace-gated.
plan_effect.prohibited_inference: Do not equate DWG viewport-list order to DXF groups 68 stacking order or 69 identity without producer/consumer evidence.
plan_effect.next_evidence: At the composed native-consumer checkpoint, compare source list order, emitted 68/69 values, layout ownership and reopened active viewport as separate observations; capture object type for each listed handle on any newly admitted version/profile.
plan_effect.claim_ceiling: No native consumer, full conversion, or support claim is established.

repository_state: Plan and locally generated fast test updated in a broadly dirty shared worktree; no changes staged or committed.
